title: The Etymological Dictionary of Latin and the other Italic Languages in LiLa (EDLIL)
work: Michiel de Vaan, Etymological Dictionary of Latin and the other Italic Languages, Leiden: Brill, 2008 (Leiden Indo-European Etymological Dictionary Series 7)
encoding: Mambrini and Passarotti 2020, 'Representing Etymology in the LiLa Knowledge Base of Linguistic Resources for Latin', Globalex 2020, pp. 20-28
repository: https://github.com/CIRCSE/EtymologicalDictionaryLatin (release v1.0, commit cda69dc). master (91fceb5, 2022-01-21) adds one triple, an rdfs:seeAlso on the Lexicon; it is the latest data.

live_check.what: SPARQL counts on https://lila-erc.eu/sparql/lila_knowledge_base/sparql: 1,437 Etymology, 2,860 Etymon, 2,653 EtyLink and 1,436 LexicalEntry with a BrillEDL etymology; equal to the release

kind_of_work: entry-centric etymological dictionary, as lemonEty RDF (Turtle): per Latin lemma, a chain of reconstructed etymons and inheritance links
holder: Michiel de Vaan (2008); LiLa (Mambrini, Passarotti) as the encoder
what_it_lacks: de Vaan's text: discussion, glosses, certainty words, cited scholars (Brill's copyright)
any link type but inheritance; borrowings and derivations inside Latin are not encoded
language tags on the Latin entries; Oscan, Umbrian and other cognates de Vaan cites
notes: Some writtenRep values hold more than a form: derivation chains with '>', grammatical labels ('acc.', 'aor.'), and two credits ('thus Schrijver', 'thus LIV') on -cellō; lila-2 must split them.
The conversion turned some h into ʰ outside forms ('tʰus Scʰrijver', 'ʰabēre'), wrote h₃ as a plain 3 in bōs, and typed a Greek omicron in *koχο‑.
One etymon uses the misspelt property lemonEty:congnate.
licence_note: The repository's LICENSE and README give CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the data; the Zenodo record's metadata says CC BY 4.0. wety follows the stricter terms, which the maintainer accepted on 2026-10-31.
may_display: the structured links and forms, with attribution to de Vaan 2008 and LiLa; non-commercial; share-alike on anything built from them
